jobs.description: About This Role Enjoy a variety of field work and office-based work Ongoing, Full Time Opportunity in Bendigo Salary Range $72,189 - $79,753 plus superannuation Do you have great communication skills and want to be a role model to people hoping for a second chance? If you want to make time to help people get their lives back on track, read on. Who are we? Community Work and Partnerships We are responsible for the development of mutually beneficial partnerships with government agencies and non-government organisations so that individuals can undertake unpaid work as part of their community-based sentence imposed by the Courts of Victoria. Community work serves as a valuable way for individuals to pay back the community while also reconnecting and reintegrating into the community. We ensure individuals make genuine efforts to undergo rehabilitation, and we keep low risk individuals out of prison and help them contribute to the community. What does a Field Officer do? Your primary responsibility as a Field Officer will be to supervise a team of clients at community work sites and other community work programs. A field officer carries out many duties and functions, mainly the supervision of individuals completing community work tasks. Other responsibilities include performing site inspections, assess hazards, providing informed workplace health and safety advice, guidance and instruction; maintaining tools and equipment resister and ensuring repairs are undertaken. A day in the life of a Field Officer. . . Your shift starts at a Justice Service Centre location where you collect a bus/ trailer with equipment. You then drive to a site to collect a group of clients, where you will induct, instruct and transport them to a partner not-for-profit organisation in the community. Tasks for the day may involve graffiti removal, painting, litter collection, mowing and weeding. Your responsibility is to instruct the individuals to safely perform each task and monitor the work performed for the partner site before returning them to the drop off point and returning to your depot. Transporting individuals is also a key part of the role and Field Officers will be required to drive a 12-seater bus with trailer. A full and current drivers' licence is essential for this position. jobs.title: Head of Brand & Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir wollen die lautesten Handpulled Noodles Europas werden. Dafür fehlt uns die Person, die das kreativ führt. Bang Bang Noodles macht Handpulled Noodles. Jede Nudel von Hand gezogen, mitten im Restaurant, so dass du es siehst, hörst und spürst. Heute zwei Stores in Berlin, Kreuzberg und Mitte. Morgen deutlich mehr: Wir bauen gerade das Franchise System auf und wollen im nächsten Jahr fünf weitere Standorte eröffnen, auch außerhalb Berlins. Dazu ein starkes Team und ein Markengesicht, das schon heute Reichweite hat. Not authentic. Just really good. Wir erzählen keine Traditionsgeschichten. Wir zeigen, was wir können, und wir sind dabei laut. Mit Absicht. Was uns fehlt, ist die Person, die diese Haltung jeden Tag in Content, Kampagnen und Markenauftritt übersetzt. Nicht als Verwalter, sondern als Motor. Aufgaben Du führst die Marke. Tonalität, Look, Guidelines, und du hast das letzte Wort bei allem, was BBN nach außen zeigt: Content, Karte, Stores, Merch, Kooperationen. Du baust unser Content System. Formate für TikTok, Reels und Stories, ein Redaktionsplan, feste Drehroutinen mit unserer Gründerin als Gesicht und der Küche als Bühne. Du produzierst selbst. Handy raus, drei Clips in der Küche, schneiden, posten. Du bist dabei nicht allein: Im Team gibt es Leute, die filmen und schneiden können und dich an festen Tagen unterstützen, und für größere Drehs holst du Freelancer und führst sie. Du entwickelst Brand Momente, die Berlin mitbekommt, von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, und steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn es welche braucht. Du lieferst Creatives für Paid Social und holst dir die Learnings zurück in die Planung. Paid selbst liegt aktuell beim Founder und kann perspektivisch zu dir wandern. Du bringst die Marke in jeden Kiez. Lokales Marketing für die bestehenden Stores und vor allem für Neueröffnungen: Launch Kampagnen, Nachbarschaft, Creator, Events. Beim Opening bist du vor Ort, auch wenn es in einer anderen Stadt ist. Du machst die Marke auch nach innen sichtbar: Employer Brand für unser Recruiting und Material und Playbooks für unsere Franchise Partner, damit jeder Standort so laut ist wie der erste. Du hast ein eigenes Produktionsbudget und entscheidest, wofür es draufgeht. Qualifikation Mindestens fünf Jahre in Brand, Content oder Kreation, angestellt oder in der Agentur. Und du hast an mindestens einer Marke mitgearbeitet, die man erkennt, weil sie Charakter hat. Consumer, Food, Lifestyle, egal welche Branche. Du kannst es selbst. Kurze Videos mit dem Handy drehen und schneiden, Texte schreiben, Plattformen bedienen. Kein Profi Cutter nötig, aber auch kein reiner Stratege. Du verstehst TikTok und Instagram aus der Praxis, nicht aus Reports. Geschmack und Haltung. Du sagst nein, wenn etwas nicht zur Marke passt, auch zu uns. Deutsch und Englisch sicher. Du bist in Berlin und willst in den Stores sein, nicht nur im Büro. Reisebereitschaft. Bei Openings in anderen Städten bist du für ein paar Tage dabei, das gehört zum Job. Benefits 60.000 bis 75.000 € brutto, je nach Erfahrung. Direkte Freigabe ohne Schleifen. Du sprichst mit den Gründern, nicht mit einem Komitee. Eigenes Office in Berlin für Konzept und Schnitt, die Stores als Set direkt vor der Tür. Eigenes Produktionsbudget und Freelancer, die du selbst auswählst. Eine Marke mit fertigem Fundament und ohne fertige Antworten. Vision, Werte und Tonalität stehen, alles andere baust du. Eine Firma, die gerade den Sprung ins Franchise macht. Was du jetzt aufbaust, wird die Vorlage für jeden weiteren Standort. Und die Rolle wächst mit: Wer heute die Marke für zwei Stores führt, führt in zwei Jahren ein Team. Weiterbildung ist uns wichtig. Eigenes Budget für Kurse, Konferenzen und Coaching, du entscheidest, was dich weiterbringt. Noodles. So viele du willst. So läuft es ab: Du bewirbst dich mit Portfolio oder Arbeitsproben und beantwortest eine Frage: Was würdest du bei uns als Erstes lauter machen? Kein Anschreiben. Dann ein erstes Gespräch mit den Gründern, 30 Minut

jobs.title: Founder's Associate - Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr. Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen, und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an. Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke, steueroptimierte Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren. Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig. Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Du baust unser Marketing gemeinsam mit den Gründern auf der grünen Wiese auf. Vieles existiert noch nicht, einiges läuft bereits: Du bringst neue Kanäle und Prozesse von 0 auf 1 und skalierst bestehende von 1 auf 10. Content, Newsletter und Performance-Marketing liegen bei dir, von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Du entscheidest, was priorisiert wird, verantwortest die Ergebnisse und stehst auch selbst vor der Kamera. Wir suchen keine Person, die Briefings abarbeitet, sondern jemanden, der das Thema Growth bei Sunpeak Capital zu 100% eigenverantwortlich ownt. Marketing- und Growth-Strategie: Du entwickelst mit den Gründern die Growth-Strategie, definierst Zielgruppen, Kanäle, Budgets und KPIs und verantwortest die Umsetzung Ende-zu-Ende. Content-Marketing von 0 auf 1 und von 1 auf 10: Du konzipierst und produzierst YouTube-Videos, Podcasts, LinkedIn- und Instagram-Formate, stehst selbst vor der Kamera und drehst mit unseren Gründern. Schnitt, Postproduktion, Thumbnails und die Adaption von Longform-Content in Reels und Shorts gehören dazu. Newsletter-Marketing: Unser E-Mail-Marketing läuft bereits. Du entwickelst es weiter: Segmentierung, Automationen, Inhalte und Lead Nurturing entlang der gesamten Investor Journey optimierst du kontinuierlich auf Öffnungsraten, Engagement und Conversion. Performance-Marketing: Unsere bezahlten Kampagnen (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, YouTube) übernimmst du und gehst stark ins Testing: neue Kampagnen, Creatives, Zielgruppen und Landingpages. Remarketing baust du neu auf. Alles ist Tracking-, Zahlen- und KPI-getrieben; du wertest die Performance regelmäßig aus und optimierst konsequent auf Lead-Qualität und Akquisitionskosten. Brand: Du entwickelst weiter, wie Sunpeak klingt und aussieht, und ziehst die Brand konsequent durch alle Touchpoints, von Social Media über Investorenmaterialien bis zu internen Präsentationen. Funnel und Daten: Du verbindest Marketing und Vertrieb, arbeitest eng mit unserem CRM (HubSpot) und machst sichtbar, welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Investoren bringen. AI-First: Du baust unser Marketing AI-first auf und hebst mit AI-Tools Effizienzen in allen Bereichen: bei der Content-Erstellung, im Schnitt, bei Creatives, in der Auswertung von Kampagnen und in der Automatisierung von Prozessen. Was manuell nicht sein muss, wird es bei dir auch nicht. Das Budget für die passenden Tools stellen wir, welche das sind, entscheidest du. Perspektive: Mit wachsendem Erfolg baust du dein eigenes Team auf und führst Praktikanten, Werkstudenten und Freelancer. Qualifikation Du hast 2 bis 3 Jahre Arbeitserfahrung im Growth- oder Marketing-Bereich eines Startups oder Scale-ups und einen Proven Track Record: Kanäle, Kampagnen oder Prozesse, die du messbar aufgebaut oder skaliert hast Du bist hands-on in mindestens zwei der drei Bereiche Content, Newsletter und Performance-Marketing und hast Lust, den

jobs.title: Controls Engineer - Rust Backend (m/f/d) for the renewable energy industry
jobs.description: The Role We are seeking a Controls Engineer (m/f/d) to work on the local controller that runs at the heart of our customers' power plants. You will design and build the control logic that keeps solar, BESS, and thermal generation assets operating safely and efficiently. A passion for the energy transition and interest in physical systems behind the code is highly valued. Tasks What You’ll Do: Design and maintain control algorithms for our Rust-based controller. Translate control theory and power grid compliance requirements into clean, well-tested code. Collaborate on the development of control algorithms for power distribution, anomaly detection, error handling and electric/thermal/economic optimization. Collaborate with engineers to validate controller behavior against real-world conditions. Build software interfaces to communicate directly with plant hardware via protocols like Modbus, CAN, and M-Bus. Support commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of controllers. Requirements What You Bring: Experience in Rust, or strong proficiency in another systems language such as C/C++. Comfort with concurrent, real-time, programming close to the hardware layer. Knowledge of, or strong curiosity about control systems or power systems. Clear, proactive communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience with industrial protocols (Modbus, CAN, M-Bus). Background in power systems, solar assets, battery energy storage systems (BESS) or similar. Benefits Why join H.E.A.T.? Future-Proof Career: Gain deep knowledge of the fast growing renewable energy sector and accelerate the global energy transition. High Autonomy: Work independently in a top-performing, diverse team with fast decisions and minimal bureaucracy. Early-Stage Equity: Receive company equity and have abundant opportunities for personal development Flexibility: Central Berlin office with hybrid remote options and flexible working hours. Growth & Pay: Competitive salary, generous personal development support, and fast career progression Ready to apply your engineering skills to a future-proof industry that truly matters? jobs.title: Software Engineer - IoT/Cloud/Edge Backend (m/f/d) for the renewable energy industry
jobs.description: The Role We are seeking an engineer to build the platform that powers our global fleet of power plant controllers. You'll develop systems that ingest, store, and transfer monitoring data from our controllers, both in the cloud and at the edge on industrial PCs. Your work will enable performance analytics, event alerts, and intelligent diagnostics that our customers depend on. Tasks What You’ll Do: Own the architecture of our centralized asset management platform. Optimize ingestion, storage and transfer of data from our control software, in the cloud and at the edge. Improve infrastructure, reliability and operations of our IoT fleet. Build products on top of plant data including performance analysis, real-time alerts and diagnostic systems. Collaborate closely with our controls team to turn plant data into useful insights. Requirements What You Bring: Strong software engineering fundamentals, regardless of your primary programming language. Wir von VOLENTUM bringen qualifizierte SAP-Spezialisten mit Unternehmen zusammen, die Verstärkung in der SAP ABAP Entwicklung, SAP-Anwendungsentwicklung, SAP-Betreuung oder bei SAP-Projekten suchen. Abhängig von Deinen Erfahrungen und Interessen finden wir eine Position, die fachlich und persönlich zu Dir passt – von der klassischen ABAP-Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender SAP-Systeme über moderne Entwicklung mit ABAP Objects, CDS Views oder SAP Fiori bis hin zur Mitarbeit bei S/4HANA-Transformationen, Schnittstellenprojekten und anspruchsvollen Digitalisierungsprojekten. Dabei suchen wir sowohl SAP ABAP Entwickler und Inhouse Developer als auch Technical Consultants und SAP-Anwendungsentwickler. Aufgaben Entwicklung, Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP-Anwendungen mit ABAP und ABAP Objects Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in technische Lösungen, z. B. Reports, Formulare, Dialogprogramme und Erweiterungen Entwicklung und Betreuung von Schnittstellen sowie Nutzung von Erweiterungstechniken wie BAdIs, User Exits oder Customer Exits Fehleranalyse, Debugging, Testing und technische Optimierung bestehender SAP-Anwendungen Mitarbeit bei SAP S/4HANA-, Migrations-, Rollout- und Digitalisierungsprojekten Je nach Schwerpunkt Entwicklung mit modernen SAP-Technologien wie CDS Views, OData, SAP Fiori oder SAPUI5 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SAP-Beratern, Fachbereichen, Key Usern und externen Partnern sowie gegebenenfalls Übernahme von Teilprojektverantwortung Deine konkreten Aufgaben richten sich nach Deinen Kenntnissen, Deinem Erfahrungslevel und der jeweiligen Position. jobs.description: Jobbeschreibung Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. jobs.title: Functional Consultant & Project Manager
jobs.description: Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership. Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base. We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. Location This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP. Your Mission As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you. Key Responsibilities Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals. Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems. Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation. Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption. Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform. What We’re Really Looking For The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end. Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift. Growth Mindset – You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game. Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions. Customer-First Mentality – You think beyond implementation — you care deeply about business outcomes and user value. What You Bring Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience. 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management. Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders. Strong analytical and communication skills — you can translate business needs into technical action. Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Venture Building Internship - New Venture (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Du quantifizierst Marktpotenziale unseres aktuell strategisch wichtigsten New Venture und führst fundierte Feasability Analysen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Enpal Experten-Netzwerk durch. Du übernimmst die volle End-to-End-Ownership für erste Projektpiloten im „ Founder Mode “: von Kundenakquise über Projektplanung bis operativer Baustellenbegleitung. Du bereitest strategische Unterlagen für C-Level Check-ins vor und unterstützt das Management direkt bei der Entscheidungsfindung. Du konzipierst und implementierst skalierbare Vertriebs- und Operations- Prozesse , um unsere Produkte deutschlandweit erfolgreich auszurollen. Du moderierst interne Workshops, um zusätzliche Wachstumspotenziale zu identifizieren und das Zusammenspiel innerhalb der Organisation zu heben. Dein Profil Du befindest dich in einem fortgeschrittenen oder hast ein sehr erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor/Masterstudium an einer Top-Tier Business School Du verfügst über Arbeitserfahrungen oder Praktika in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen wie z.B. Startups oder in einer Unternehmensberatung/Consulting Du zeichnest dich durch eine proaktive und stark lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus Stark analytische Arbeitsweise mit der Kompetenz, komplexe Probleme zu dekonstruieren und Botschaften strukturiert (Top-down) zu vermitteln Exzellentes praktisches Urteilsvermögen sowie die Fähigkeit zur konsequenten Priorisierung nach dem 80/20-Prinzip Du hast eine zielstrebige Arbeitsweise und hohes Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an Dich selbst und andere und legst eine Can-Do-Mentalität an den Tag, die andere motiviert Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. De

jobs.description: We are hiring a Head of Brand to own how Pairs shows up in the world. The brand, the content behind it, the video we put out, and the small team that makes it with you. Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast. The role You own the brand. What Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the image a founder or investor meets before they ever talk to us. You set the strategy and you run it. Most weeks that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You run the story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest through to the final cut, and you cut video yourself. There is a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly one, and a quarterly report we want the category to quote. Paid comes later, once we turn it on, and you own the brief behind every campaign. You also get a team, VC Content Interns who live in this space, write daily, and grow into full-time seats under you. You report to the co-founders, strategize with them, and get real creative freedom. This is a player-coach seat and both halves are real. People who stopped writing and editing when they got their first team will not enjoy this. Neither will someone who has never had anyone reporting to them, though we will hear the case. All of it is aimed at one thing. When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good. What you will own Positioning, voice and look, held consistent everywhere from the site to the feed to the newsroom. Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, the newsletter on our site, the monthly one, and the quarterly report. You write them and you ship them. Founder and investor story shoots, from booking and prep through shoot day to the edit, with you cutting. Sponsorships and retargeting, planned and measured against inbound. VC Content Interns you brief, edit and grow into full-time hires. Content structured so AI answer engines and journalists quote us, with share of voice tracked and SEO fundamentals underneath. You are a fit if you Have built and run a brand end to end that we can open: a named brand where you set the voice, made the content, ran the channels, and know the before and after numbers from memory. Still make it yourself. You write the posts, cut the video, direct the shoot. When we ask what you made versus what you briefed, the answer is specific. Have managed makers: a small team, freelancers, or interns, and grown at least one of them into a bigger job. Write at a high bar in a restrained register, and can point at published work longer than a caption. Have run paid for a brand, sponsorships and retargeting included, or owned the brief and the results while someone else ran the hands. Know how AI answer engines and journalists pick what to cite, and have shipped work with that reader in mind. SEO fundamentals are assumed. Can take one piece that outperformed and explain exactly why, and one that flopped and what you changed. Bonus: you already live in the founder and VC corner of the internet, a personal following among founders or investors, podcast or newsletter production, on-camera comfort. What we offer Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours, because that is when this audience is online. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights. The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan. Main missions include: Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs). Value proposition and pricing : Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment? Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management. P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L. Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights. We are currently hiring for new segments: It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built. We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years. ⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️ At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.) Full working proficiency in French At least advanced level in English An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty A prior experience working with senior leadership You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelon

jobs.description: The AI Enablement Team is the catalyst for internal transformation and product acceleration across Actian. In the modern data landscape, AI is not a siloed experimental lab; it is a core capability that must be embedded into our product DNA and our engineering workflows. We are looking for an AI Enablement Lead who will architect, scale, and own our AI enablement strategy end-to-end. LLMOps & Governance Infrastructure: Establish strict guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring tools to track model performance, bias, data privacy, and security across all AI implementations. Standardization of Tooling: Define and enforce the organization's official AI stack, from vector database selection and vector embeddings strategies to semantic caching mechanisms. Vendor & Open-Source Strategy: Evaluate and manage partnerships with AI model providers and lead the technical assessment of cutting-edge open-source models to keep Actian at the vanguard of innovation. Data-Driven Impact Tracking: Define and track operational metrics for the AI Enablement function, such as developer adoption rates, reduction in time-to-market for AI features, and ROI of implemented AI tools. Qualifications & Profile: Technical Background: Strong background as a Senior AI/ML Engineer, LLMOps Engineer, or Software Architect who has successfully built and scaled AI-powered applications in enterprise SaaS or complex data platforms. AI & Engineering Mastery: Deep technical expertise in Python or Go, semantic search, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector), orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and fine-tuning or prompt engineering of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Software Engineering Rigor: You treat AI development as software engineering. You understand CI/CD, unit testing for AI (evaluation datasets), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and clean code architecture. Influence Without Authority: Exceptional leadership and communication skills. jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: Comand AI's mission is to build next-generation C2 software with real users in real deployments in the field. We are fully indexed on the success of every single user, which means even an early concept has to make a complex operational idea clear and credible. The BD Product Designer turns a promising customer conversation into something people can see, use, and react to quickly. This role is distinct from core product design. Core product designers go deep on durable product experiences; you help the business development team make a future capability tangible, then feed what you learn back into product. jobs.description: Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership. Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base. We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. Location This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP. Your Mission As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you. Key Responsibilities Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals. Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems. Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation. Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption. Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform. What We’re Really Looking For The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end. Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift. Growth Mindset – You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game. Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions. Customer-First Mentality – You think beyond implementation — you care deeply about business outcomes and user value. What You Bring Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience. 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management. Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders. Strong analytical and communication skills — you can translate business needs into technical action. Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster. Within that focus, you are the third voice beside the founders on people decisions: who we hire, who we promote, who we bet on, when we part ways. You read people precisely, see early where they are heading, and say it out loud in the room where it counts. No process replaces that; ours is built to support it. The same logic extends beyond the founders: to our decision-makers you are an advisor, not an order-taker. You read the talent market and tell them what their plans will cost, you sharpen how we present ourselves to candidates, and you build pipelines for the roles we will need before we need them. You will not start from zero. Over the past year we built our People Guild: values translated into observable behaviors, a leveling framework with Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser who holds a veto, a lean feedback cycle. You inherit the engine mid-build, documented, with deadlines and founder sponsorship. You finish it, run it, and make it yours. #What you will do Hiring: Full-cycle recruiting for few, senior, often technical roles. Outbound-first: you map markets and build pipelines from scratch rather than waiting for applications. You run the culture screen as the first interview of every process and protect the hiring bar, founders included. Culture: Our ADEPT values as a working rubric. Every interview, feedback cycle and promotion scores against it, and you keep it sharp. Development and retention: Leveling, salary bands, a semi-annual feedback cycle, promotion rounds, VSOP administration, retention bets on key people. Tooling and automation: Our ATS contract ends next year; you pick and roll out its successor. You build automations across our ATS, Notion and Humaans so manual work keeps shrinking and your time keeps moving toward talent and culture. #What we offer People decisions at a 40-person company are company decisions, and you make them with the founders VSOP participation like everyone here: if the Operating System for Renewables becomes what we are building, that stake is meaningful Salary band shared in the first conversation, not after four rounds Development: educational leave, a steep curve by design Team & culture: regular offsites Mobility & health: JobRad, up to 100% Deutschlandticket subsidy, pension plan, Wellpass/Urban Sports, childcare subsidies Requirements #What you bring Full-cycle recruiting experience from high-paced environments: a high-growth startup or scaleup, the talent team of a VC or PE firm, or a top search firm, including senior and engineering searches you sourced and closed yourself. You use LLMs daily and can walk us through real workflows you built: sourcing and market mapping, structured screening support, scorecard synthesis, drafting at scale. Run the experiment, and read it honestly . Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently. Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. jobs.title: Founding Creative Director
jobs.description: Meet Siena Siena is the The Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns. It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on. The team We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do. We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock. If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading. The role Siena is building the intelligence layer for CX, and we're about to launch several products in quick succession. We are not looking for someone to execute a brief well. We are looking for the person whose taste the rest of the company gets measured against: someone who looks at a landing page and can't not have an opinion, who would rather kill a launch than ship something mediocre, and who has owned creative direction before, not just contributed to it. If you need a creative director above you setting the vision, a team to delegate to on day one, or a slow, considered, one-project-at-a-time pace, stop reading now. This isn't that job. If you're the person other designers already defer to on taste, continue. This is a craft title. Not a headcount title. You will ship personally for the first year and set the bar for everyone who comes after. Over time you will build a small internal agency, two to three people across design, motion, and content, that can brief, position, and launch without outside help. Narrative and positioning across every launch - design as strategy, not decoration Every artifact that goes to market: landing pages, launch video, decks, social The design system, from v3 onward The bar, full stop - if it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it What it takes to be in the room Taste, above everything, and evidence you can defend it. Specific, defended opinions about what's good and why. A track record of owning creative direction, not just contributing to it. Agency or in-house, brand refresh or full launch - you've been the person whose call was final, not the one waiting on notes. Narrative thinking. Design as positioning. You should already have a point of view on how a brand like Siena should be positioned, not just how it should look. AI as a working tool, not a threat to your taste. You've already built something with AI - an app, a prototype, a mockup - and you want to get technical enough to ship a landing page yourself within a year. Anti-AI is disqualifying. Range that travels. Your background doesn't have to be SaaS. Fashion, art, consumer brand, editorial - what matters is whether your taste holds up somewhere new. A pattern of shipping in chaos, not around it. Multiple launches in flight, feedback that moves in hours not weeks. If your best work happens on a slow, protected timeline, that's useful information - it's just not this role. Why this is worth it You're not joining a design team to fit into. You're setting the taste bar for a company that's about to be a lot more visible, a lot faster than most companies get that chance. This is intense - real ownership, real launches, a founder team that reviews your work directly and moves at the pace you'd expect from that. It's also one of the rare creative seats where nothing you make gets diluted by committee before it ships. If that sounds like the room you've been trying to get into, we want to talk to you. If it sounds like too much scrutiny too fast, this isn't a knock on you - it just isn't this role. Why Siena? Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager i

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager (Financial Risk)
jobs.description: Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth. We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Over the past few years, our client base has grown 20 times to over 4 million, and client assets have grown over 50 times to over €5 billion. Role Overview The Senior Risk Manager (Financial Risk) will provide an independent second line of defence oversight, challenge and assurance over the Firm's financial risk profile, with a particular focus on liquidity risk, market risk and counterparty credit risk. You will play a key role in ensuring the ICARA process and Wind-Down Plan are robust, appropriately challenged and effectively embedded, working closely with Treasury, Trading and Finance first line teams. This role requires deep technical expertise in financial risk management, prudential regulation and capital/liquidity adequacy within an FCA-regulated investment firm. What you'll do Provide independent second line oversight, challenge and assurance over the Firm's liquidity risk, market risk and counterparty credit risk exposures, ensuring these remain within Board-approved risk appetite. Own and continuously enhance the 2LOD monitoring framework for liquidity risk, covering funding risk, market liquidity risk, intra-day liquidity risk, settlement risk, foreign currency position risk and liquidity concentration risk. Understand and challenge Group wide market risk exposures including interest rate risk, FX risk, trading risk, asset concentration risk and the Firm's exposure to extreme market events. Oversee and challenge the Firm's counterparty credit risk framework, including credit processing and aggregation risk, credit appetite and policy, and the identification of emerging credit risks and adverse counterparty trends. Provide second line input into the ICARA process, ensuring liquidity adequacy and capital adequacy risks are appropriately identified, quantified and stressed, and providing credible challenge to first line methodologies and assumptions. Ensure the Wind-Down Plan is fit for purpose, appropriately triggered via early warning indicators, and regularly tested, challenged and updated in line with regulatory expectations. Oversee and challenge liquidity stress testing and scenario analysis, including severe but plausible and reverse stress test scenarios, to assess resilience under stressed conditions. Review and challenge the effectiveness of first line risk management performed by Treasury and intr-Group Trading entities/ functions, including the design of liquidity buffers, trading limits and counterparty credit limits. Support the identification and enhancement of quantitative and qualitative risk appetite measures for financial risk, ensuring appropriate tracking, escalation and remediation of breaches. Deliver periodic independent 2LOD assurance through thematic reviews and deep dives into Treasury operations and counterparty exposure management. Maintain oversight of relevant financial risk registers, ensuring risks are appropriately identified, assessed and tracked to resolution. Provide second line risk review and challenge for new products, trading venues, asset classes and strategic initiatives that could materially affect the Firm's liquidity, market or counterparty credit risk profile. Support ongoing monitoring of early warning indicators and contribute to Recovery and Resolution planning where relevant. Foster a healthy risk culture, promoting risk management as a universal responsibility and encouraging open, transparent discussion of financial risk issues without fear of retaliation. What you need to have Extensive experience in liquidity risk, market risk and/or counterparty credit risk management, ideally within an FCA-regulated investment firm, broker or trading platform. Strong working knowledge of the FCA's MIFIDPRU framework, including the ICARA process, liquidity adequacy

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - French Speaking (Europe)
jobs.description: Location: Remote in Europe Salary: Competitive base + Commission About Nivoda 🚀 Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise. Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry. Our Mission 🎯 Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them. The Team ⭐️ Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast. About the Role 🤔 You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours. This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held. What will you be doing? 😎 Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos. Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure. Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly. Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches. Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy. Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert. What do we need from you? 💪 1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity. A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day. Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them. Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1. Native or professional proficiency in English and French is required for this role. Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are. Our culture and what we offer 😉 At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability. Our current benefits 🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture 💻 Remote work 🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning 🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance 🚀 Chance to join and contribute

Our Mission 🎯 Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them. About the Role 🤔 Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us. Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for. Function one: enablement Training and standards Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there. Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how. Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar. Documentation and materials Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice. Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed. The channel to marketing Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer. The channel to product Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when. When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it. Function two: conversion Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there. Call scoring Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise. Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it. Send the reports out every week, to everyone. Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team. Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten. Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster. KYC Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip. Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed. Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written. Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team. How we will measure it 💻 Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort. KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average. Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly. 80% compliance against the ru

Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. jobs.description: About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn. We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes. You'll help answer questions such as: Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value? Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation? What drives repeat usage, retention and churn? Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance? How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments? If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you. What you'll do Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation . Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding. Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist. Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics. Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value. Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities. Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes. Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted. Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement. Here, you'll be instrumental in connecting LiveScore Media and LiveScore Bet, crafting customer journeys that are not just seamless and personalised, but genuinely exciting. You'll be the architect behind integrated, data-driven campaigns, optimising every customer interaction to maximise value and orchestrate experiences that hit the mark every time.</p> <p>This role challenges you to blend strategic thinking with hands-on execution, driving innovation in customer engagement through cutting-edge marketing technology. You'll not only shape our customer experience but also nurture the growth of junior team members, becoming a key operational leader in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Success means seeing your campaigns soar, your insights transform customer journeys, and your mentorship empower others.</p> <p>At LiveScore Group, we’re the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We’re proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fuelling fan’s passion for sport driving us to the top.</p> <p>We don’t just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it’s our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition.</p> <p>As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you’re good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you’re passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you!</em></p> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent CRM in weekly marketing planning sessions, ensuring alignment with broader strategies.</li> <li>Coordinate campaign activity across various marketing channels, including Acquisition, Promotions, Casino, Sportsbook, Content, and LiveScore Media.</li> <li>Align CRM communications with promotional calendars, sporting events, and commercial priorities.</li> <li>Build and optimize automated customer journeys for acquisition, onboarding, first deposit, engagement, and reactivation.</li> <li>Identify and implement improvements for customer progression between LiveScore Media and LiveScore Bet.</li> <li>Drive continuous refinement of customer journeys based on performance data and behavioural insights.</li> <li>Champion the effective use of our marketing technology stack, including Innovid, CRM platforms, and audience segmentation tools.</li> <li>Lead campaign QA across all CRM channels, ensuring best practices and regulatory compliance.</li> <li>Deliver insightful campaign reporting, including incremental analysis and commercial performance.</li> <li>Mentor and support CRM Executives, fostering their growth and acting as a first point of escalation for delivery issues.<strong>&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul&

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Commissioning and Characterisation
jobs.description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.</p> <p>You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.</p> <p>Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.</p> <p>You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together.</p> <p>We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.</p> <p>You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other.</p> <p>One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems.</li> <li>Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence.</li> <li>Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams.</li> <li>Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. We actively welcome applications from engineers to the profession through a returnship or after a career break.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li>Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li>Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li>Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li>Workplace experience: Enjo

jobs.description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. Your Mission Your mission is to bring the right small businesses to Credit Compass - those who find genuine value in the product and come back to use it regularly. We’re looking for an Acquisition Lead to join our Credit Compass team. This is a London-based role and requires at least one day a week in the office. We already have paid channels working well on Meta, Google and TikTok, so you won't be starting from scratch. Your job is to scale what's working, launch new channels from the ground up, and run a structured experimentation programme across paid, owned and partner channels. Together, these help us learn which audiences, messages and journeys find the businesses Credit Compass can help most. The team is made up of 8 people across design, analytics, product and tech, you’ll report into the Credit Compass Lead. You’ll lead the acquisition function with scope to hire an additional team member in the short term. Working closely with product and data, you'll turn early signals into clear insights: who Credit Compass is for, the problem it solves best and how to reach those businesses efficiently. If it goes well, you'll build a growth engine with a clear path from 10,000 to 100,000 users within a year. Meta, Google and TikTok are already working - take them further by testing new audiences, creative and landing pages, and pushing efficient growth. Launch new channels from scratch , across paid search and social, referrals, affiliates and partner distribution, with a focus on learning what scales and what doesn't. Define the right customer segments for Credit Compass , designing and running experiments that reveal which businesses find long-term value and come back regularly. Connect the right message to the right audience , writing and testing ad and landing-page copy, validating our messaging matrix and iterating based on real customer behaviour. Improve conversion from existing demand , testing ways to turn low-performing organic pages and existing iwoca traffic into engaged Credit Compass users. Build a test-and-learn growth engine: set clear hypotheses, run A/B tests, analyse results and turn insights into repeatable acquisition strategies. Work closely with retention teams to feed learnings back into the product and help shape how Credit Compass evolves. Autonomous and execution-focused , able to define experiments, launch tests, and move work forward without waiting for perfect briefs or constant oversight. Experimentation experience , including designing A/B tests, interpreting results, and making decisions in the presence of noisy or imperfect data. Data-literate and numerate , comfortable reading dashboards, questioning results that don’t make sense, and using data to guide decisions (SQL not required). As a Data Scientist, you'll work with people across each function. AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't. Communication . We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Job Description Checkout.com is seeking an Specialist, Deal Analyst to join our growing Sales Operations team in our London office to support our global growth. This role sits within our Commercial department. We are looking for someone who is highly motivated, detail-oriented and confident in collaborating cross-functionally with internal teams throughout the organisation. Within this role, you will be working with teams such as Sales, Legal, Risk, Onboarding and Finance. jobs.title: Strategist, Agent Development (Norwegian speaking)
jobs.description: About us At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. What you'll do As an Agent Strategist , you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business. Own the Agent Development Life Cycle . Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome. Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there. Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch. Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next. Example projects These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently: Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers. Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation. Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples. Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner. Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week. What you'll bring Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships. Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences. Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast. Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - rea

jobs.title: Director, Product Data Analyst Team
jobs.description: Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.   We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.   Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.   Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog. As a Product Data Analytics Director, you will lead and develop a team of four analysts dedicated to our core product for all sales-driven business (another data analytics manager handles our self-serve initiatives). In close collaboration with three different VP/SVP of Product, you will leverage data with your team to drive strategic decision-making and optimize product performance. This role is integral to our product team, ensuring data-driven decisions guide our product strategy and innovation efforts.  You’ll join the Product Insights department, composed of the Product Data Analytics team and Product Research team. In charge of having a 360 customer knowledge view, we combine quantitative and qualitative insights to inform the product roadmap.  Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Insights, you will ensure your team is aligned with the broader company goals and operates with the velocity required to influence strategic decision-making.   What you'll do Strategic Alignment: Understand the vision of the different product groups you support and ensure that your team’s focuses on the highest priority topics.
